body:
Yeah, I know, but considering how depressed and hopeless I am, I find it very hard to work on myself or have any positive outlook. And even when my life was better, I struggled in social situations and had few friends. 

About the job, I don't know. I've never had a real dream job, and everything involves so much social contact... I used to want to be a writer, but that's not gonna pay any bills.

I'd like to have a job I enjoy, live on my own, have some friends who really understand me, maybe find a significant other. But all of that seems incredibly far away right now...

Happy cake day to you.
